text:
marta: Heads-up — hit an odd onboarding friction with the ruby sampleapp. The app uses dotenv but on my machine the process env wins and the sample never picks up the REDWOOD_API_KEY from .env. Works if I export first. MacOS 12, ruby 3.1, bundler 2.4. :confused:

josh: ugh. do you mean the sample's README suggests `dotenv` but the code requires it after config load?

marta: yeah exactly. sampleapp/lib/setup.rb does `config = load_config` then `require 'dotenv/load'` so if you run `REDWOOD_API_KEY=foo bundle exec ruby sample.rb` it picks env, but if you rely on `.env` it sometimes doesn't because load_config reads ENV early.

olivia: can you paste the minimal repro? also which gem versions?

marta: quick repro: create `.env` with `REDWOOD_API_KEY=local_abc`, then run `bundle exec ruby sample.rb`. sample prints `nil` for key. stack: `ruby 3.1.4`, `dotenv 2.8.1`, `redwood-sdk 0.7.2`.

josh: that matches: if `load_config` is invoked at file-load time (top-level) it will snapshot ENV before dotenv loads. two quick fixes: 1) move `require 'dotenv/load'` to top of entry file so ENV populated before any config parse, or 2) change load_config to call `Dotenv.load` as fallback when ENV key missing.

marta: I can do a tiny PR for option 1 (change sample app only) and also add note to README about precedence. is option 2 viable for SDK? might surprise users if SDK mutates load behavior.

josh: agreed — SDK shouldn't implicitly call Dotenv. it introduces an extra dependency and surprising side effects. keep SDK pure; update sampleapp and docs.

olivia: :+1: sampleapp PR is best. also add a one-liner in quickstart: "If you're using .env files, ensure `require 'dotenv/load'` runs before sample initialization"

ci-bot: CI started for branch fix/sampleenv-2154329999 (runs: unit, lint)

marta: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/42 — changes: move dotenv require to `bin/run` and add README paragraph. small tests added to assert ENV populated in sample-run.

josh: quick review comments: nit on wording and add changelog entry under /docs/quickstart.md. tests look fine.

olivia: also add a short note in `CONTRIBUTING.md` about avoiding top-level config reads that touch ENV during file load — we've seen similar in other sampleapps.

marta: updated PR addressing comments, CI green. merged to main. thanks for the quick checks everyone. :tada:

olivia: can we also add a tiny lint rule in repo to flag top-level `ENV[...]` usage? maybe too heavy. at least mention in code review checklist.

josh: code-review checklist entry makes sense. I'll add it to our devex checklist doc later.

marta: closing the thread — fixed in sampleapp and README. leaving here for searchability if others hit it.
